117:t_1:3.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「...That concludes my report on the situation, as well as my personal request.」

117:t_1:4.en:
$$カティ$$
「Understood. We'll continue our own investigation into the units that broke away from the chain of command.」

117:t_1:5.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Is it $$クロノ$$ after all...?」

117:t_1:8.en:
$$カティ$$
「I'm a Brigadier General. ...Honestly... I'll never get used to it, no matter how much time passes.」

117:t_1:9.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「I've gotten used to the name $$パトリック・マネキン$$ already, though.」

117:t_1:10.en:
$$カティ$$
「Never mind. Half of this transmission is private, so I'll overlook a little joking around.」

117:t_1:11.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「In that case, a few whispered words of love and such...」

117:t_1:12.en:
$$カティ$$
「Don't push your luck. Even on a completely private transmission, I'm not inclined to say anything like that.」

117:t_1:13.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「I know, I know. That kind of thing isn't for a transmission, it's for when we actually meet in person, right?」

117:t_1:14.en:
$$カティ$$
「...That side of you is what saves me...」

117:t_1:15.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「But I'm sorry, Colonel. I... don't think I'll be able to see you for a while.」

117:t_1:16.en:
$$カティ$$
「So it's about that petition from earlier...」

117:t_1:17.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「To break out of this situation, the only way is a one-point breakthrough by concentrating our forces.」

117:t_1:18.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Though I may not be up to it, I'd like to join $c myself.」

117:t_1:19.en:
$$カティ$$
「So you've started thinking about strategy, too... My lectures weren't wasted after all.」

117:t_1:21.en:
$$カティ$$
「Lieutenant $$パトリック・マネキン$$'s request is granted. From now on, join the independent unit $c and serve under its command.」

117:t_1:23.en:
$$カティ$$
「While I'm at it, I'm giving you one more mission. I want you to act as a guide.」

117:t_1:24.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「What's that supposed to mean?」

117:t_1:25.en:
$$カティ$$
「There's someone who has thought along the same lines as you. Join $c together with him.」

117:t_1:26.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Is it someone I know?」

117:t_1:27.en:
$$カティ$$
「A dependable man. He should be arriving there about now.」

117:t_1:30.en:
???
「I'm glad to be able to fight alongside you again.」

117:t_1:31.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Likewise. $$プリベンター$$ Lightning.」

117:t_1:35.en: ～ $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ Briefing Room ～

117:t_1:36.en:
$$レイアム$$
「...As I've already explained, the $$新地球皇国$$ has laid $$レイライン$$s across this North American continent as well, and has built $$ターミナル・ベース$$s in various places.」

117:t_1:39.en:
$$レイアム$$
「And the one that ties them all together and serves as the center of the enemy's strategy on this continent is the $$セントラル・ベース$$.」

117:t_1:40.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Conversely, if we capture that $$セントラル・ベース$$, we can swing the war in our favor all at once.」

117:t_1:41.en:
$$レイアム$$
「The war here in North America between the $$地球連邦$$ and the $$新地球皇国$$ has been evenly matched until now, but...」

117:t_1:42.en:
$$レイアム$$
「With $$ネオ・ジオン$$ and $$クロノ$$ openly starting to cooperate with the Empire, the $$地球連邦$$ will be put at a disadvantage.」

117:t_1:43.en:
$$オットー$$
「In short, we have no time to spare.」

117:t_1:44.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「Naturally, a defensive line with a large force has been prepared around the $$セントラル・ベース$$.」

117:t_1:45.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「So if we charge in blindly, we'll just get crushed, huh.」

117:t_1:46.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「After consulting the $$連邦軍$$, we've settled on this plan: they make a large diversion nearby while we break into the $$セントラル・ベース$$.」

117:t_1:47.en:
$$バナージ$$
「We'll be the force that decides the battle...」

117:t_1:48.en:
$$アムロ$$
「But there's also the recent incident with $$ダバラーン$$. The $$サイデリアル$$ are probably watching our movements, too.」

117:t_1:49.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「I believe there's an opening there that we can exploit.」

117:t_1:51.en:
$$オットー$$
「That's right. We draw the enemy's attention as a diversion, so that the diversion force can deploy.」

117:t_1:52.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「If we make a big show of it, the Empire will have no choice but to shift its forces to us... Then the main Federation force will find it easier to move.」

117:t_1:53.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「And if that opens a hole in the enemy's defensive line, the main Federation force will launch a breakthrough from there into the $$セントラル・ベース$$.」

117:t_1:54.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Each is the other's diversion, and either could be the real thing...」

117:t_1:55.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「If that's settled, let's go all out and cause a ruckus.」

117:t_1:56.en:
$n
「Agreed. If we give those guys a rude shock, our morale will go up, too.」

117:t_1:57.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「I figured someone would come up with that kind of hot-blooded opinion, so I've already decided on our target.」

117:t_1:58.en:
$$オットー$$
「To start with, $c will capture the $$ターミナル・ベース$$ in $$オーティス$$, Texas.」

117:t_1:59.en:
$$マリー$$
「$$オーティス$$...? That's a place name I feel like I've heard somewhere...」

117:t_1:62.en:
$$カツ$$
「A girl who was a member of $$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$. I've never met her myself, though.」

117:t_1:63.en:
$$アムロ$$
「She's a junior of $$クロウ$$, the $$スフィア・リアクター$$ of the $$揺れる天秤$$, and like him, she's a $$次元獣$$ Buster.」

117:t_1:64.en:
$$フォウ$$
「《$$次元獣$$》... Those are the huge hostile creatures that appear from another dimension, right?」

117:t_1:65.en:
$$アムロ$$
「They've hardly been seen since the $$再世戦争$$ in the $$ＡＤＷ$$ ended, though.」

117:t_1:66.en:
$$カツ$$
「If she's a $$次元獣$$ Buster, she must be with that Dr. $$トライア$$...」

117:t_1:67.en:
$$カツ$$
「Then it'd be nice if she joined $c.」

117:t_1:68.en:
$$ファ$$
「Now that you mention it, you're right... You could say there are no more $$次元獣$$ left anyway.」

117:t_1:69.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「Even more so since her hometown has become a $$サイデリアル$$ base. I'd like her to fight with us.」

117:t_1:70.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「She must have her reasons, too.」

117:t_1:72.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「...I hear $$オーティス$$ is where the first $$次元獣$$ ever appeared in the $$ＡＤＷ$$, though...」

117:t_1:73.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「That's right. Because of that, the town was wiped out, except for $$エスター$$...」

117:t_1:75.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「According to Dr. $$トライア$$'s research, that town is apparently inside a dimensional distortion.」

117:t_1:76.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「$$次元獣$$ emerged from a flaw in the dimensional boundary there, and in the $$時獄戦役$$ it was one of the places hit hardest by the slowing of time.」

117:t_1:77.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「And now a base of the $$新地球皇国$$ is being built there.」

117:t_1:78.en:
$$マリー$$
「So it's a town that was tossed about by the multiverse...」

117:t_1:81.en:
$$オットー$$
「A fair amount of force has gathered at $$オーティス$$. If we can take it, it will serve as a diversion against the Empire and, at the same time, a foothold for assaulting the $$セントラル・ベース$$.」

117:t_1:82.en:
$$オットー$$
「We depart in three hours. Everyone, get ready.」
